title: blend compound
explanation:
### Description

Test vtkImageBlend compound mode with various foreground/background combinations.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkActor2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor2D.html) — actor2d.
- [vtkBMPReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBMPReader.html) — bmp reader.
- [vtkImageAppendComponents](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageAppendComponents.html) — image append components.
- [vtkImageBlend](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageBlend.html) — image blend.
- [vtkImageCanvasSource2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageCanvasSource2D.html) — image canvas source2d.
- [vtkImageLuminance](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageLuminance.html) — image luminance.
- [vtkImageMapToColors](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageMapToColors.html) — image map to colors.
- [vtkImageMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageMapper.html) — image mapper.
- [vtkImageShrink3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageShrink3D.html) — subsamples an image by averaging neighboring voxels.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkTIFFReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTIFFReader.html) — reads TIFF image files.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
